price_bucket_skip_filter_bug.description: The _PRICE_BUCKET_RE = r'-(?:B|T)\d' regex requires a digit immediately after B or T (e.g. -B1 or -T1). Markets using -T-<number> suffix (threshold markets: KXAAAGASD-T-4.500, KXAUNABCONF-T-30) are NOT caught by this filter because the T is followed by a dash, not a digit. These are threshold/price-bucket markets that should be excluded from structure_arb but are leaking through.
price_bucket_skip_filter_bug.fix: Update regex to r'-(?:B|T)[\d-]' or r'-T-\d' for threshold markets, or add a category-based filter for Economics macro-release events.
price_bucket_skip_filter_bug.impact_on_backtest: 5 of 7 resolved losses (KXAAAGASD x3, KXAUNABCONF x2) are from these leaking bucket/threshold markets. Without them, the only resolved event is KXCHINAANNOUNCE (1 win, 0 losses). The negative gross_pnl is entirely attributable to the filter bug.
